author: New China TV
description:
Disputes have troubled the waters of the #SouthChinaSea for decades. But who has the true claim to #sovereignty?

In this episode of #ChinaChat, host @miaoxiaojuan speaks with curator Xin Lixue at the China (Hainan) Museum of the South China Sea, where #shipwrecks, punch bowls, and handwritten route books all have a story to tell!

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: China Chat | South China Sea: What History Reveals

author: New China TV
description:
Turpan might be known as China's "Land of Fire," where temperatures can soar to 50 degrees Celsius, but locals have turned life in this scorching basin into a sweet, refreshing oasis.
Click the video to discover their ingenious ways of beating the heat -- and see why the warmth of the people outshines the intense summer heat.
title: Fire & sweetness: Exploring unexpected oasis of Turpan, Xinjiang

title: Large protest held in Tokyo, online against Takaichi government's dangerous policies

#heartwarming #teamwork #rescue #firefighters
title: Firefighters bring mom and newborn to safety in muddy rescue

description: China's national observatory on Saturday issued a red alert for rainstorm, the highest level in its four-tier system, with Typhoon Bavi expected to make landfall along the coast of eastern China in the early hours of Sunday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China issues highest-level alert for rainstorms as Typhoon Bavi approaches

author: New China TV
description: Amid chest-deep floodwaters in Binyang, Guangxi, south China, a rescuer held a 5-month-old baby high above his head and carried the infant to safety. The baby stayed dry throughout the rescue and was safely reunited with the mother.
title: 5-month-old baby held high above floodwaters in heartwarming rescue

author: New China TV
description:
A finless porpoise, a national second-class protected animal, was found stranded on a beach in China's Liaoning. Tourists rushed to help, using a canvas mat to keep the animal wet and setting up a safe area until wildlife rescue personnel arrived. After several attempts amid strong waves, the porpoise was successfully released into deeper waters and swam back to the sea.
#WildlifeRescue #FinlessPorpoise #China
title: Stranded finless porpoise rescued in NE China

author: New China TV
description: A 3-month-old baby, who had run out of formula in the floods, was safely rescued in Guangxi, China. The fireman rescuer later admitted: "I've never feared fires or floods, but holding this tiny life made my hands shake." #heartwarming #rescue #China
title: Firefighter wades through deep water to rescue 3-month-old infant

author: New China TV
description: Shelters stocked. Ports secured. Emergency teams ready. As Typhoon Bavi nears China's eastern coast, communities are taking precautionary steps to protect lives and critical infrastructure. #TyphoonBavi #China
title: China braces for Typhoon Bavi with orderly preparations across east coast

author: New China TV
description:
A forum on the role of soft power in the enduring governance of the Communist Party of China was held in Shanghai on Friday.
During the forum, the delegates engaged in in-depth discussions on topics including the governing philosophy of putting the people first, the guiding role of theoretical innovation, and the firm commitment to peaceful development.
title: Shanghai forum highlights role of soft power in CPC's enduring governance

author: New China TV
description:
International journalists, experts, and scholars gathered in Shanghai this week for the Hong Ting Forum themed "The Enduring Governance of a Century-Old Party: The Role of Soft Power." 
Beyond forum sessions, they stepped out of conference venues to explore the city. The immersive city tour allowed them to experience China's cutting-edge innovations, and to learn about the country's progress and the century-long development history of the Communist Party of China.
title: Int'l guests explore China's future, history in Shanghai

author: New China TV
description:
Edgar Snow's legacy lives on in Tongxin County, a revolutionary heartland in northwest China's Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region where a bronze bugler sculpture marks the spot first captured by the American journalist 90 years ago.
Today, Tongxin is part of China's broader transformation, having emerged from poverty after a national campaign lifted nearly 99 million rural residents out of destitution by 2020. 
#EdgarSnow #TongxinCounty #FlyOverChina
title: 60"FlyOverChina | Retrace Edgar Snow's route: Tongxin from above

author: New China TV
description: At a forest park in Pu'er, southwest China's Yunnan Province, a white-browed gibbon stretched out on the ground for a relaxing "massage" from its keeper. The laid-back primate looked completely at ease, soaking up every moment of its summertime pampering with unmistakable enjoyment. The heartwarming scene has delighted animal lovers, offering a charming glimpse of the close bond between the gibbon and its caregiver.
title: A gibbon's summer day massage
